title: Admon ben Gadai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: At the beginning of Mishnah Ketubot, chapter 13, the two judges of penalties in Jerusalem are Admon and Chanan ben Avishalom. The Gemara, Ketubot 105a, gives Admon ben Gadai. Seven rulings of his remain in the Mishnah; Rabban Gamliel endorses three with “Admon’s words seem right to me.” One is familiar to everyone: “Have I lost out because I am male?”

notes.text: The notice reports seven rulings and three endorsements; these are counts within the cited account, not a count of people.
